shortDescription: Saves podman image to tar file

options.name: compress
options.description: Compress tarball image layers when pushing to a directory using the 'dir' transport. (default is same compression type, compressed or uncompressed, as source)

options.name: dest
options.description: Destination file to write image to.

options.name: executable
options.description: Path to C(podman) executable if it is not in the C($PATH) on the machine running C(podman)

options.name: force
options.description: Force saving to file even if it exists.

options.name: format
options.description: Save image to docker-archive, oci-archive (see containers-transports(5)), oci-dir (oci transport), or docker-dir (dir transport with v2s2 manifest type).

options.name: multi_image_archive
options.description: Allow for creating archives with more than one image. Additional names will be interpreted as images instead of tags. Only supported for docker-archive.
